name: Haunted Club Manager 88
source:
One of the most infamous sport "kusoge" (crap game), released in 88 for an old computer, is suddenly relevant again when a weird rumor appears on the internet.

According to the rumor a rare cartridge of the game has been found in the black market, containing a different version of the game with a bizarre story. Is the story true or just a publicity stunt by the game developers?

[From [url=https://wandeer.itch.io/haunted-club-manager-88]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
最臭名昭著的游戏之一“kusoge”（垃圾游戏）于88年在一台旧电脑上发布，当互联网上出现一个奇怪的谣言时，它突然再次变得重要。

据传言，在黑市上发现了该游戏的稀有卡带，其中包含具有奇异故事的不同版本的游戏。这个故事是真实的还是只是游戏开发商的宣传噱头？

[来自[url=https://wandeer.itch.io/haunted-club-manager-88]itch.io[/url]]
